why: Keep it, since a pet that shares its seeds with everyone nearby is exactly the open, generous spirit this guardian believes in.

veto.quote: borrowed work without credit; any doubt about a license; anything that breaks the repo's licensing rules (every port credited, nothing GPL); lock-in.
veto.why: Unless the picture's credit and license show beside the pet, it hands over borrowed work without credit.

style: Warm, open pose and clean outlines, with each pet's credit listed beside its sprite sheet.
making: Record each pet's maker, tool, and image terms beside its sheet, since AI-drawn art's license must be beyond doubt.
